correctness.rationale: PASS: Pairwise error-ball disjointness equals exclusion of differences E+E. Every difference supported on the last four coordinates can be split into allowed burst patterns on {3,4} and {5,6}; first-two-coordinate projection is injective, proving code size<=4 even for nonlinear codes. Independently re-created all 64 error balls, graph adjacency and enumerated all four-cliques, obtaining exactly 192 and verifying closure under XOR after translating a chosen word; exactly 12 distinct direction subspaces and 16 cosets each. Translation-plus-reversal action has 7 orbits with sizes 16,16,32,32,32,32,32. Finite exhaustive enumeration is a complete proof for this specific 64-vertex problem, not a mere partial sample.

final_claim: For binary strings of length 6 correcting a single noncyclic burst of length at most two (E={0,e_i,e_i+e_{i+1}}), the maximum code size is 4, and there are exactly 192 labeled maximum codes; all are affine 2-flats, from 12 direction planes with 16 cosets each, forming seven orbits (two size16 and five size32) under binary translations and coordinate reversal.
limitations: Noncyclic adjacent burst, length exactly 6, binary alphabet, at most two adjacent flipped positions.
No claim concerning the full graph automorphism group or longer codes.
